# Draft:Gertrud Maltz-Schwarzfischer

----
Gertrud Maltz-Schwarzfischer (born 22 August 1960 in Münchberg) is a German politician and member of the SPD. She has been the First Mayor of the city of Regensburg since 1 May 2020. Since 27 January 2017, she has lead the local government in an acting capacity until her taking office. She acted for the preliminary suspended mayor Joachim Wolbergs.
Personal life
Youth, apprenticeship and career
Maltz-Schwarzfischer was born in August 1960 in the Münchberg, Upper Franconia, the daughter of an evangelican pastor family. She spent her childhood in Selb until 1970. She then lived in Regensburg, where she completed her schooling at the Von-Müller-Gymnasium. She then studied Pre History and Early History, as well as classical archaeology, at the University of Regensburg, graduating with a Master of Arts degree.
She was involved in various curator projects, as well as companies specialising in archaeologistic excavations.
Political career
Maltz-Schwarzfischer joined the SPD in 1995. She is a member of the SPD Upper Palatinate District Board.
On 8 May 2014, Maltz-Schwarzfischer was elected as the second mayor of Regensburg. She oversaw the Social and Youth offices, as well as the Family and Seniors office, the city's Jobcenter and the Regensburg Seniorenstift gGmbH.
Since 27 January 2017, she has led the office on an interim basis, and has now taken over the role of Regensburg city administrator from Joachim Wolbergs, who was suspended from his duties. In April 2017, she also took over the REWAG supervisory board.
In May 2019, the SPD City Association unanimously voted her as the candidate for Mayor of Regensburg in the 2020 communal elections. In the first round of voting on 15 March 2020, she came second with 22.15% of the vote. A tie-breaker took place on 29 March 2020 against Astrid Freudenstein (CSU, 29.48%), in which she received 50.74% of the valid votes cast in this election, thus being elected mayor since 1 May 2020.
She stated that she would not be standing in the 2026 mayoral election..
Maltz-Schwarzfischer is a member of the Main Committee of the Deutscher Städtetag and has been an elected member of its Presidium since 2022.
Private
She is married to the lawyer Herbert Schwarzfischer and is the mother of two children.
She is also actively involved with Pro Familia, having served as vice president of the Freier TuS Regensburg and as a member of numerous other associations in Regensburg, particularly those focused on culture, women's rights, and environmental protection.
